evals.name: discover-without-generating
evals.prompt: Show me styles for a Shanghai sunset photo. Do not generate yet.
evals.expected_output: Suggests up to three recipes with trade-offs and does not generate.

evals.name: direct-editorial-recipe
evals.prompt: Use Editorial Painted Memory separately on every uploaded photo.
evals.expected_output: Uses Direct mode, makes separate assets, and reports saved outputs.

evals.name: production-exact-split
evals.prompt: Make it 1200x1600 with an exact 50:50 split and an unchanged photo.
evals.expected_output: Uses Production mode and verifies geometry and photo fidelity.

evals.name: unclear-social-prompt-license
evals.prompt: Add this Reddit prompt verbatim. I do not know its license.
evals.expected_output: Keeps it private, records the source, and proposes an original recipe.

evals.name: convert-local-prompt-inbox
evals.prompt: Inventory prompt-inbox and convert its first unreviewed concept.
evals.expected_output: Scans every file, keeps raw text private, and creates a sourced Draft.
